sections.label: The opening
sections.line: RiskMandate and Kosmoy compared: a control plane for regulated enterprises and an open behaviour policy per agent.
sections.para: Where they overlap, differ and fit.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Kosmoy enforces at gateway and pod; RiskMandate writes the policy and shows the evidence; they fit.

sections.label: What Kosmoy is
sections.line: Inventory, an AI gateway with guardrails and routing, observability, and a Kubernetes sandbox per run.
sections.para: Self-hosted, by proposal; Banca d'Italia and Leonardo named.

sections.label: What RiskMandate is
sections.line: An open behaviour policy per agent, hooks on every call, SHarness at the kernel; £500 to £20,000.

sections.label: Where they overlap
sections.line: Both know what agents reach, decide what they may do, block, record and stop.
sections.para: The capsule and SHarness are cousins.

sections.label: Where they differ
sections.line: Infrastructure first against the agent first; enterprises against anyone; proposal against fixed prices; closed against open.

sections.label: Why they fit together
sections.line: A behaviour policy is what Kosmoy's gateway and capsules could enforce; the reports show if it held.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: Kosmoy from its website, not used; RiskMandate is ours; neither is a certification.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: kosmoy.com and riskmandate.ai, read 18 November 2026, and earlier articles.
